posts.text: One of the ironies is that the ‘Kamala lost bc of what she tweeted in 2020’ logic should actually now be applied to Gaza. And it’s not some survey or tweet, she was the vice president. Can’t come back from it zero chance.
posts.summary: Gaza policy was disqualifying for Harris's candidacy
